name: Oshtor
source: [spoiler]To fulfill Oshtor's aspirations, Haku wears the mask, so that he may act in his friend's stead. He makes use of Oshtor's status and connections along with his own intelligence in order to put Anju on the imperial throne.[/spoiler]
translation: [spoiler]To fulfill Oshtor's aspirations, Haku wears the mask, so that he may act in his friend's stead. He makes use of Oshtor's status and connections along with his own intelligence in order to put Anju on the imperial throne.[/spoiler]
